notes.title: Solitude Patch 1.1 is live!
notes.content:
We’ve been thrilled by your support and feedback since launch—your reports have been invaluable in helping us improve Solitude. Today we’re rolling out Patch 1.1, which brings a series of fixes and enhancements across various aspects of the game.


Gameplay & Mechanics Fixes
Fixed a bug in the quicksave system

Fixed an issue in the regeneration system that prevented health recovery

Enemies now react correctly to player death

The “Practice makes perfect” achievement now triggers only after 10 deaths
World & Visual Improvements
Fixed the rendering issue with palm leaves in the South-West Oasis

Unstuck a sandcrab in the south-western area of the map

Changed the Toolbox name to better reflect its appearance
Text & UI Fixes
Corrected a translation error

Fixed an extra space in the Outpost questline text
Miscellaneous
Added a private Beta Branch for testing upcoming features

Fixed a missing collision component on an element tied to a secret achievement



Thank you once again for your continuous feedback and support. We’re always listening.

Haven’t played yet? Add Solitude to your Steam library and join the community!

– The Jerboa Interactive Team
